name: self_report
one_line: The run is done when it says it is done.
how_it_works: Check that a reply arrived and claims to be an answer.
pros: Free. No second pass, no second implementation.
It is what a system does by default, so measuring it prices doing nothing.
cons: Caught nothing. All five injected faults were accepted.
The confident wrong answer is exactly the case it cannot see.
Gives an acceptance signal that carries no information.
pick_this_when: Wrong answers are cheap and visible downstream.
You are prototyping and know this is the baseline.
avoid_when: Anything acts on the answer without a human reading it.
